title: Logotype / Rotation
slide_intent: Adapt orientation to the available space because a rigid horizontal treatment can waste a narrow format.
strategic_value: A controlled vertical option can let Duolingo maintain a large signature on unusual placements.
demonstration: Horizontal and vertical specimens distinguish the default 0° orientation from an occasional 90° treatment.
practical_value: Use the horizontal default, or the vertical option when it increases useful scale in a narrow format.

content_islands.name: Orientation pair
content_islands.spec: Place labeled horizontal and vertical examples side by side in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Default and exception
content_islands.spec: Explain ordinary 0° use and the formats that justify 90° in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy says vertical rotation makes better use of unusual formats and permits larger display.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples include skyscraper ads, banners, flags, merchandise and stationery.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The section identifies 0° as default and 90° as an occasional alternative.

ingredient.name: Logotype rotation
ingredient.role: Fit identification to the format while preserving its drawing.
ingredient.application: Use 0° by default and 90° when an unusual format benefits from a larger vertical mark.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. The source describes selected narrow or playful applications; it does not permit arbitrary angles.
